title: Man Thinks He’s Invincible to Police, Doesn’t End Well
description:
On November 28, 2021, deputies of the Monroe County Sheriff’s Office responded to a report of a disturbance call. It was discovered that a man destroyed a residence and left on foot armed with a knife. Deputies located him 1 mile north of the residence walking on the roadway. After several minutes of negotiation, the man continued to ignore commands of the deputies believing that he might be invincible to the law...
